title: Westborough police chief allegedly found ‘hammered drunk’ in Shrewsbury liquor store parking lot
author: Brendan Nordstrom
bullets: Local News The Town of Westborough placed Chief Todd Minardi on administrative leave Saturday.

Police officers were responding to a wellness check at a liquor store parking lot Friday afternoon when they found Westborough police Chief Todd Minardi in his unmarked cruiser beside empty bottles of vodka, Shrewsbury police said.
Police believe Minardi, who according to officers had glassy eyes and slurred words, spent more than 24 hours in the parking lot until a passerby called 911.

title: Driver killed in 3-vehicle crash on Route 20 in Shrewsbury
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Local News An oil tanker truck sustained secondary damage while stopped in the eastbound lane during the crash, police said.
A driver was killed in a three-vehicle crash Monday on Route 20 in Shrewsbury, authorities said.
The collision occurred shortly before noon at the intersection of Edgemere Boulevard on Hartford Turnpike, the Shrewsbury Police Department said in a press release.
